queries_run: FICO Mortgage Direct License Program credit bureaus tri-merge resellers 2026

findings.claim: FICO 2025年10月宣布房貸直接授權計畫，tri-merge 轉售商等可不經三大信用局直接計算並分銷 FICO 分數；2026年4月 FICO Score 10T 也納入；信用局相關營收占總營收 FY2026/2025/2024 為 60%/51%/45%。
findings.excerpt: In October 2025, we announced a significant change in the delivery of FICO® Scores to the U.S. mortgage industry. With the announcement of the FICO® Mortgage Direct License Program, tri-merge resellers, platform providers, and other third-party distributors will have the option to calculate and distribute FICO Scores directly to their customers (e.g., mortgage originators), without relying on a consumer reporting agency as an intermediary.

findings.claim: FICO 預期隨 FICO Platform 能力增加，間接通路（聯盟夥伴、轉售商、系統整合商）銷售將成長，並投入大量資源發展。
findings.excerpt: As more capabilities are made available on FICO® Platform, we expect our sales through indirect channels to grow. We are investing significant resources to develop our indirect channel relationships.

findings.claim: 直接授權計畫提供 tri-merge 轉售商兩種定價：每分 $4.95 權利金（較平均降約50%）或維持每分 $10；Cotality、Ascend、Xactus、CIC Credit 已加入；Equifax、TransUnion 公告後股價下跌。

note: 搜尋僅下1次，聚合站價格細節未讀原頁。
